text:
anya: Quick sync from the postmortem follow-up thread — we need explicit owners and realistic deadlines for the vendor-related mitigations. please confirm assignments.

matt: I'll take the multi-region cloud gating + DNS failover work. Plan: prototype in staging by next Tue, deployment in two sprints after validation. assigning: matt. :thumbsup:

sara: I'll own model-registry resilience (artifact caching, download token TTLs, and metric exports). Draft runbook by Friday. assigning: sara.

lucy: ops will add provider health dashboards, composite alerts, and an on-call playbook entry. target: Wed next week. assigning: lucy.

tim: I'll handle auth SDK hardening: circuit breaker, cached verification-only tokens, and rotation alerts. question: do we prefer a read-only fallback token or a temporary write-capable token for critical flows?

anya: prefer verification-only fallback to minimize blast radius. small short-lived write token only for emergency runbooks and strictly gated.

matt: cloud plan notes:
```
- health gating: mark region unhealthy after 3 failed probes
- failover window: staged traffic shift 1% -> 10% -> 50% (30m holds)
- DNS TTL: 60s for canaries, 300s for general traffic
```
I'll open infra PR with health probe scripts.

sara: registry plan snippet:
```
- download tokens: 5m TTL, refresh endpoint
- local artifact cache: soft-ttl 10m, stale-while-revalidate
- expose registry latency metric, SLO 200ms
```
I'll post a test harness Monday.

tim: auth SDK prototype:
```
- circuit breaker (open after 3 errors / 5s)
- verification-only fallback token stored in KMS-wrapped blob
- daily smoke test exercise for fallback path
```
I'll PR a feature-flagged toggle so teams can opt-in gradually.

anya: we observed a recurring pattern: auth blips + registry latency compounded outages. action: composite alert that correlates third-party error rates with service SLO drops. lucy, can you wire that?

lucy: yes. composite alert: fire when registry errors >1% AND auth failures >0.5% for 10m. runbook step will include: "scale down non-critical background jobs" + paging to oncall + notify eng leads.

matt: what's our minimum-viable mitigation (MVM) to ship in 14 days? I propose: provider health gating (matt) + registry local cache (sara) + basic SDK circuit breaker (tim).

anya: agree. MVM owners: matt/sara/tim. target: 14 days. I'll block sprint capacity.

sara: noted. will prioritize cache + instrumentation PR this week.

tim: will open SDK PR with circuit breaker behind feature flag.

deploy-bot: matt deployed infra/health-gating:staging at 2191238005 by matt — status: success. :white_check_mark:

anya: thanks — great progress. next: update the postmortem action tracker with owners, deadlines, and acceptance criteria. I'll run a weekly 15m "Dependency Mitigation Standup" until items are closed.

lucy: calendar invite sent for weekly check-ins.

matt: will add short runbook snippet to runbooks repo and tag @oncall when we run traffic shifts.

anya: perfect. ping here if you hit blockers; otherwise we'll close and re-open as needed. :v:
